gameDescriptionHtml:
Claim your bounty
Choose between a more story focused adventure or step into brutal, lightning-fast shootouts where every movement matters. Dodge, dive, and outmaneuver the ruthless barons of the Underwest and the deadly creatures who serve them. Master powerful weapon abilities, chain together stylish combat techniques, and fight your way through the Underworld.

A Living Graphic Novel
Journey through the haunting world of the Underwest, brought to life with striking hand-drawn animation and cinematic presentation. Leap across beautifully crafted panels inspired by the visual storytelling of Genndy Tartakovsky (Samurai Jack, Primal), blending graphic novel style with fluid action and atmosphere.

Descend Into the Wild West Underworld
Explore surreal spirit realms steeped in mystery, violence, and decay. From forgotten ghost towns to cursed frontiers beyond death, every corner of the Underwest hides new dangers, lost souls, and buried truths waiting to be uncovered.

Grand story of loss and devotion
The Soul of Rosebud, daughter of former outlaw gunslinger, Rose, has been imprisoned in a locket by Envy, one of the Seven Deadly Sins. To free her daughter, Rose must do his bidding. True to his name, Envy craves the power possessed by the other Deadly Sins.

Guide Rose as she journeys into the Underwest – the wild west’s mysterious underworld. Hunt down Pride, Greed, Lust, Gluttony, Wrath, and Sloth, and collect their bounties for your new master.

Traverse a dark, yet vibrant world below. Test your acrobatic gunslinging skills in dynamic boss battles featuring high-energy 360° shooting galleries. Uncover the mysteries of Rose’s past as she once again relies on her trusty six-shooter.

But be warned: nothing is quite as it seems.

Delivered in a bold, handcrafted, cinematic style with full voice acting and narration, Rose and Locket blurs the line between graphic novel and game experience.
